{{Quote|Wait. There's something very weak coming through.|Wyron Serper picks up a communication from the probe droid|<ref name="ESB" />}}
'''Wyron Serper''' was a [[Gender|male]] [[human]] who served as a [[captain]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] as the senior [[controller]] of the command center in the Alliance's [[Echo Base]] on the [[planet]] [[Hoth]]. In [[3 ABY]], he and the base's [[commander]], [[General]] [[Carlist Rieekan]] discussed an unidentified blip that had been detected near the base with [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] and her companions [[Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca]].

After Serper played a weak signal coming from the blip, Solo and Chewbacca left to investigate it and discovered it to be the [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Viper probe droid]] [[XJ9-CS14]]. The [[droid]] alerted the Empire to the Alliance's presence on Hoth, forcing the Alliance to evacuate as the Imperials [[Battle of Hoth|attacked]].

==Biography==
{{Dialogue|Rieekan|Picked up something outside the base's Zone 12 moving east.|Serper|It's metal.|Organa|Then it couldn't be one of those creatures.|Solo|Could be a speeder, one of ours.|Serper|No.|attr=Carlist Rieekan, Wyron Serper, Leia Organa, and Han Solo discuss the probe droid|src=<ref name="ESB" />}}
The [[human]]<ref name="ESB" /> [[Gender|male]] Wyron Serper served in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] as part of its fight against the [[Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Junior Novel" /> In [[3 ABY]], Serper held the rank of [[captain]]<ref name="Ion Control">{{StoryCite|story=Ion Control|book=From a Certain Point of View: The Empire Strikes Back}}</ref> and was serving as the senior [[controller]] in the command center of [[Echo Base]], the Alliance's secret headquarters on the [[planet]] [[Hoth]].<ref name="Junior Novel" /> [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] was perched next to Serper's station when the [[smuggler]] [[Han Solo]] informed [[General]] [[Carlist Rieekan]], the base's [[commander]], that he had to leave Hoth due to the [[Bounty|price]] on his head. After saying a tense farewell to Organa, Solo bolted out of the center, and the princess stormed after him, all sense of duty to what she was helping Serper with forgotten.<ref name="Ion Control" />

When the Alliance picked up an unidentified blip moving east past the base of [[Zone Twelve]], Rieekan called Organa over to Serper's console in the command center, where the general and the controller were viewing the blip's movements near the base on a map. Rieekan explained the situation to Organa and her companions [[Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca]], with Serper adding that it was made of metal. Organa used this information to rule out the possibility of it being one of the [[Diet|predatory]] [[wampa]] they were dealing with, while Solo suggested it might be one of their own [[speeder]]s. Serper denied this, then adjusted the controls on his [[headset]] and reported that they were getting a weak signal from the unidentified object, turning on an audio speaker so the others could hear it.<ref name="Junior Novel" />

The [[protocol droid]] [[C-3PO]] then informed the group that the signal was not one used by the Alliance, suggesting it might be Imperial. Solo then left with Chewbacca to head out and locate the source of the signal, while Rieekan ordered Serper to have [[Rogue Ten]] and [[Rogue Eleven]] of [[Rogue Squadron]] move to [[Station 3-8]]. Solo and Chewbacca discovered the blip to be the Imperial [[Viper probe droid]] [[XJ9-CS14]], which alerted the Empire to the presence of the rebels before self-destructing. The Alliance then began to evacuate Echo Base, but were soon [[Battle of Hoth|attacked]] by the Empire, who claimed victory on Hoth but failed to stop many rebels from escaping.<ref name="Junior Novel" />

==Personality and traits==
Wyron Serper had fair skin and [[Color|brown]] [[hair]].<ref name="ESB" />

==Equipment==
While in the Echo Base command center, Serper wore a white [[Clothing|bodysuit]] with a brown, sleeveless, high-collar [[jacket]] and made use of a headset.<ref name="ESB" />

==Behind the scenes==
Wyron Serper first appeared in the [[1980]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']]. The character was portrayed by [[Burnell Tucker]] in the film and credited only as one of several "Other Officers." Tucker also portrayed [[Romas Navander]] in the film,<ref name="ESB" /> and had previously played the character [[Del Goren]]<ref name="Tucker">{{WebCite|url=https://www.hollywoodmemorabilia.com/en/star-wars/burnell-tucker-star-wars-autographed-1996-star-wars-ccg-number-100-bas-authenticated-card-with-best-wishes-inscription/t-24061638+p-342245908180674+z-9-2953284177|text=Burnell Tucker Star Wars Autographed 1996 Star Wars CCG #100 BAS Authenticated Card with "Best Wishes" Inscription|archivedate=20230617112514}}</ref> in [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']].<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref> Serper's scenes in the Echo Base control room were shot on Stage 1 at [[Elstree Studios]] between [[March 26]] and [[March 28|28]], [[1979]].<ref name="MakingOf">''[[The Making of The Empire Strikes Back]]''</ref>

In the new ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], Serper was first identified in a [[Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (paperback novel)|paperback novelization]] of ''The Empire Strikes'' back written by [[Ryder Windham]] and released in [[2017]].<ref name="Junior Novel" /> The name originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where it was first used in [[1996]] on a card in the ''[[Hoth Limited]]'' expansion set of the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]].<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Hoth Limited|cardname=Wyron Serper}}</ref>
